mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) which may be exacerbated by disulfiram's hepatotoxic potential and effects on mineral metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and hepatic function closely; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider alternative antivirals if possible.
